Generate Python code that uses the Cloudflare API to start a tunnel from a Flask app, using the `requests` library to make HTTP requests to the Cloudflare API and the `Flask` framework to run the app:
```
import requests
from flask import Flask

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/")
def index():
   # Start the Cloudflare tunnel
   response = requests.post("https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/tunnels", json={"title": "My Tunnel"})
   if response.status_code == 201:
       print("Tunnel started successfully")
   else:
       print("Error starting tunnel:", response.text)
   return "Hello World!"

if __name__ == "__main__":
   app.run(debug=True)
```
This code creates a Flask app that starts a tunnel using the Cloudflare API when the `/` route is accessed. The `requests` library is used to send a POST request to the Cloudflare API to create the tunnel, and the response is checked for errors.
